method: Stable input slice(17,34); 17 live originals and all 19 distinct group members read; each original UTM independently transformed to WGS84. 63 actual web search queries, then primary/history/current-use direct reading where available. No historical coordinates, roads, source fields, global data or other batch files changed.

records.outcome: 原汉壁礼女校与同组1300日本领事馆警察处均为147 BOONE ROAD、年代空缺，原点完全相同。历史指南记Hanbury Home在Boone／Nanzing路口；1916年工部局报告区分男童迁Haskell新校与女童留Boone旧址。两原点在缓存北虹高中院区内只是空间相容，尚无材料把该女校、领事馆警察处与现南浔路281号逐段闭合。两成员各自使用时段、旧建筑存废及现址关系待核，整组保留。
